main_products: Outerwear: down jackets, windbreakers, functional workwear, technical coats, insulated and ski jackets, hunting wear
woven_evidence: Its range is outerwear made from waterproof, windproof and breathable technical fabrics (woven shells). It does list T-shirts as a minor category.

canton_fair.evidence_note: The company's own news pages announce booth 6.1D37-38, E11-12 at the 138th fair. A second page (lotogarment.com/news/meet-hebei-loto-garment-at-the-137th-canton-fa-84944985.html) gives the same booth for the 137th fair, Phase 3, May 1-5, 2025.

notes: Its China address is an office in Hebei COFCO Plaza, Shijiazhuang. The site also lists factories in Bangladesh and Africa and a UK office, so Layer 2 should check where production actually happens. Published contacts: info@lotogarment.com, +86 15633045017 (WhatsApp).
